messages:
user-jordan: Hey team — running into a streaming issue with the Node SDK on an edge runtime. Customer on Fly.io edge: ReadableStream stops delivering after ~12KB, then hangs until timeout. Using @redwood/sdk-js v0.9.1. Anyone seen this?

alex-support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a minimal repro and the response headers?

user-jordan: Minimal snippet from their app: 
```js
const res = await client.stream({ model: 'rw-1-small', prompt: '...' });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if (done) break;
  console.log('chunk', value?.length);
}
```
Headers shown by the backend service: `transfer-encoding: chunked`, `content-type: text/event-stream`, `connection: keep-alive`.
Logs: last console.log shows chunk 12288 then nothing for ~30s, then SDK times out and returns error. This happens only when deployed to Fly edge runtime. On regular Node server it's fine.

maria-eng: Two quick Qs: 1) Is the app using any fetch polyfills or undici pinned at runtime? 2) Does the SDK get a chance to `clone()` the response anywhere (we do that in some older versions)?

user-jordan: They are on Node 20 but running in Fly edge (which uses V8-based edge runtime). No extra polyfills. Not intentionally cloning.

sam-runtime: I can try to reproduce. Quick hypothesis: some edge runtimes implement ReadableStream slightly differently and if Response.clone() or tee() is used that can prematurely lock the stream. Which SDK method are you calling exactly?

user-jordan: Using the high-level streaming helper: `client.stream(...)` which returns a web Response-like object (res.body is a ReadableStream).

alex-support: Can you run `curl -N` directly against the model endpoint from the same region? That'll tell us if the upstream is chunking correctly. Also any proxy/ingress between edge runtime and our host?

user-jordan: Did `curl -N` from the Fly instance — it receives a steady stream of chunks. So upstream is fine. I also attached a tiny repro: `https://github.com/jordan/edge-stream-repro` (private gist) — starts at root and reproduces in their Fly org.

sam-runtime: Pulling the repro now. Reproduced locally on a small Fly app. I can see the stream yield a few chunks then stop. Debugging shows the SDK's stream wrapper calls `ReadableStream.prototype.pipeThrough` to attach a transform for telemetry — that transform uses a default queuing strategy which appears to deadlock with the platform's backpressure.

alex-support: Oof. Do you have a quick workaround we can give the customer while we fix the SDK?

sam-runtime: Two workarounds: 1) If you can bypass the SDK wrapper and use the raw fetch on the endpoint, the stream is fine. Example: 
```js
const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
// same read loop as before
```
2) Upgrade to the SDK pre-release where I removed the transform and use a non-blocking passthrough: `npm i @redwood/sdk-js@0.9.3-rc.1` — that fixes it in my local tests.

user-jordan: Tried the raw fetch approach — works. Customer confirmed they can use that as a stopgap. Any ETA for official patch?

sam-runtime: Creating a small PR to avoid using pipeThrough for edge runtimes and instead use a light-weight reader proxy. Draft PR: https://internal/repo/pull/4589. CI bot will run tests.

ci-bot: CI started for PR 4589 — running unit + integration streaming tests.

maria-eng: Can you also add a feature flag in the SDK to disable the transform (e.g., `streaming: { telemetry: false }`) so we don't need a full release for urgent customers?

sam-runtime: Good idea. Added `streaming.experimentalTelemetry = false` to the PR for quick toggles.

alex-support: Customer asked about compatibility — will this change affect Node server runtime or only edge?

sam-runtime: Safe for both. The new code prefers a reader-proxy when `typeof Deno !== 'undefined' || navigator?.userAgent?.includes('Fly') || process?.env?.REDWOOD_EDGE === '1'` — but we also expose the feature flag so they can force it. We ran end-to-end across Node 18/20 and Fly edge.

user-jordan: Great. Customer tested rc.1 and confirmed streaming stable and no hang. Any notes for billing/auth parts? They previously saw intermittent 401s when the stream retried after timeout.

alex-support: The 401s were likely from auth token expiry during the retry window. Recommend short-term: avoid automatic retry on streaming requests or refresh tokens proactively. We'll add guidance to the docs.

sam-runtime: PR merged to main and scheduled for patch release 0.9.3. Release notes: "fix(edge): avoid blocking stream transform on edge runtimes; expose streaming.experimentalTelemetry flag".

user-jordan: Closing the loop — customer upgraded to 0.9.3 today and reports stable stream. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex-support: Nice work team :rocket:
